cioWhyNow.title: CIO challenger: why now
cioWhyNow.body: Seven recurring operational decisions show where fragmented coordination can become a governed Curavias preview.
cioWhyNow.tableLabel: Operational decisions: Today compared with Curavias Preview
cioWhyNow.caption: Illustrative qualitative comparison — no live business metrics.

bed-allocation.today: Reactive on the morning of admission and under time pressure.
bed-allocation.preview: Planned from the shared capacity outlook instead of improvised at handover.

or-slots.today: Cancellations and empty slots are discovered on the operating day.
or-slots.preview: Cancellation risk and redistribution options become visible ahead of the decision.

staffing.today: Short-notice pools and local workarounds cover emerging gaps.
staffing.preview: Rosters align to forecast demand and skill requirements.

discharge.today: Readiness and blockers are unclear during the morning coordination cycle.
discharge.preview: Candidates, blockers, and hand-offs are visible before the operational window.

transfers.today: Decisions are ad hoc and communication happens under pressure.
transfers.preview: Transfer cascades are previewed and partner organisations can be involved earlier.

crisis.today: Response doctrine remains in documents separate from live operating signals.
crisis.preview: Scenario-led recommendations connect trusted signals to the approved doctrine.

data-quality.today: Quality issues surface only after a KPI reaches a report.
data-quality.preview: Quality gates alert before an affected measure enters an operational decision.
